---
title: "Build employment panel"
date: "2026-04-25"
output: pdf_document
---

```{r}

# Stack BLS OES / OEWS National Industry-Specific 4-digit NAICS employment
# files for 2016-2024 into a single panel-ready CSV for AIIE construction.

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

oes_folder <- "../Data/Source data/Employment source files"

employment_csv <- "../Data/Intermediate data/oes_panel_2016_2024.csv"

clean_names <- function(df) {
  names(df) <- names(df) %>%
    str_to_lower() %>%
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "_") %>%
    str_replace_all("^_|_$", "")
  df
}

pick_col <- function(df, candidates) {
  hit <- intersect(candidates, names(df))
  if (length(hit) == 0) NA_character_ else hit[1]
}

get_year <- function(fname) {

  m <- str_extract(fname, "20(1[6-9]|2[0-4])")
  if (!is.na(m)) return(as.integer(m))

  m2 <- str_extract(fname, "(?i)(?<=m)(1[6-9]|2[0-4])(?=[^0-9]|$)")
  if (!is.na(m2)) return(as.integer(paste0("20", m2)))
  NA_integer_
}


# Read one OES file 
read_one_oes <- function(path) {
  ext <- tools::file_ext(path) %>% str_to_lower()
  na_strings <- c("", "NA", "**", "*", "#", "***", "*****")

  raw <- switch(
    ext,
    "xlsx" = read_excel(path, sheet = 1, na = na_strings, guess_max = 100000),
    "xls"  = read_excel(path, sheet = 1, na = na_strings, guess_max = 100000),
    "csv"  = read_csv(path, na = na_strings, show_col_types = FALSE),
    stop("Unsupported file extension: ", ext)
  )

  df <- clean_names(raw)


  occ_code_col    <- pick_col(df, c("occ_code", "occcode"))
  occ_title_col   <- pick_col(df, c("occ_title", "occtitle"))
  naics_col       <- pick_col(df, c("naics"))
  naics_title_col <- pick_col(df, c("naics_title", "industry_title", "naicstitle"))
  o_group_col     <- pick_col(df, c("o_group", "occ_group", "group"))
  i_group_col     <- pick_col(df, c("i_group", "naics_group"))
  tot_emp_col     <- pick_col(df, c("tot_emp", "totemp"))


  required <- c(occ_code_col, naics_col, tot_emp_col)
  if (any(is.na(required))) {
    stop("Missing required column in: ", basename(path),
         "\n  Need OCC_CODE, NAICS, TOT_EMP.",
         "\n  Found columns: ", paste(names(df), collapse = ", "))
  }

  out <- df %>%
    transmute(
      occ_code    = as.character(.data[[occ_code_col]]),
      occ_title   = if (!is.na(occ_title_col))   as.character(.data[[occ_title_col]])   else NA_character_,
      naics       = as.character(.data[[naics_col]]),
      naics_title = if (!is.na(naics_title_col)) as.character(.data[[naics_title_col]]) else NA_character_,
      o_group     = if (!is.na(o_group_col))     str_to_lower(as.character(.data[[o_group_col]])) else NA_character_,
      i_group     = if (!is.na(i_group_col))     str_to_lower(as.character(.data[[i_group_col]])) else NA_character_,
      tot_emp     = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[tot_emp_col]]))
    )

  
  if (any(!is.na(out$o_group))) {
    out <- out %>% filter(o_group == "detailed")
  }


  if (any(!is.na(out$i_group))) {
    out <- out %>% filter(str_detect(i_group, "4.?digit"))
  } else {
    # Fallback: NAICS is either bare 4-digit ("3361") or padded to 6 ("336100")
    out <- out %>%
      mutate(.naics_str = as.character(naics)) %>%
      filter(
        str_detect(.naics_str, "^[0-9]{4}$") |
          str_detect(.naics_str, "^[0-9]{4}00$")
      ) %>%
      select(-.naics_str)
  }

  out
}


# Loop over files 
if (!dir.exists(oes_folder)) {
  stop("Folder does not exist: ", oes_folder,
       "\n  Update `oes_folder` at the top of this script.")
}

files <- list.files(
  oes_folder,
  pattern = "\\.(xlsx|xls|csv)$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

if (length(files) == 0) {
  stop("No .xlsx/.xls/.csv files found in ", oes_folder)
}

cat("Found", length(files), "candidate file(s) in", oes_folder, ":\n")
walk(files, ~ cat("  -", basename(.x), "\n"))

panel_list <- list()

for (f in files) {
  yr <- get_year(basename(f))

  if (is.na(yr) || yr < 2016 || yr > 2024) {
    message("Skipping (no 2016-2022 year detected in filename): ", basename(f))
    next
  }

  cat("\nReading ", basename(f), " (year = ", yr, ") ...\n", sep = "")

  one <- tryCatch(
    read_one_oes(f),
    error = function(e) {
      message("  FAILED: ", e$message)
      NULL
    }
  )
  if (is.null(one)) next

  one$year <- yr
  cat("  -> ", nrow(one), " rows kept after detailed/4-digit filters\n", sep = "")

  panel_list[[as.character(yr)]] <- one
}

if (length(panel_list) == 0) {
  stop("No files produced usable rows. Check filenames and column names.")
}


# Stack and save 
panel <- bind_rows(panel_list) %>%
  arrange(year, naics, occ_code) %>%
  select(year, naics, naics_title, occ_code, occ_title,
         tot_emp, o_group, i_group)

cat("\n=== Panel summary ===\n")
panel %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    rows         = n(),
    n_naics      = n_distinct(naics),
    n_occs       = n_distinct(occ_code),
    tot_emp_sum  = sum(tot_emp, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_suppressed = sum(is.na(tot_emp)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  print()

write_csv(panel, employment_csv)
cat("\nWrote ", nrow(panel), " rows to ", employment_csv, "\n", sep = "")
```
